picks.title: This chip startup just raised $135M on a bet that AI's biggest bottleneck isn't compute — it's memory
picks.why_it_matters: A $135M Series raise at $570M valuation signals strong investor conviction in memory-as-bottleneck thesis, potentially opening opportunities for startups building memory-optimized AI infrastructure.

picks.title: After Nvidia's $20B not-acqui-hire, AI chip startup Groq reportedly raising $650M
picks.why_it_matters: Groq's pivot from hardware to AI inference software while raising at scale validates inference as a massive market opportunity and suggests strategic openings for startups in the inference stack.

picks.title: Shift will clean homes for free to train future robots
picks.why_it_matters: A novel data-collection-as-service model for robotics training data signals creative approaches to the real-world data bottleneck that could spawn new startup models in embodied AI.
